content.title: About
content.content: Potato tots are small bite‑size pieces of grated potato that are coated in a seasoned breadcrumb crust, flash‑frozen and intended for oven baking. When baked they develop a crisp golden exterior while remaining soft and fluffy inside.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Tots are a classic side dish for burgers and salads in North America.
Freezing locks in flavor and texture, allowing quick preparation any time.
In the United States and Canada they are commonly called "tater tots".
A high‑starch potato variety is used to achieve the characteristic bite.
Baking instead of deep‑frying reduces added fat compared with traditional fries.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potatoes are rich in potassium, which supports normal blood pressure and muscle function.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: A modest amount of vitamin C remains after freezing, providing antioxidant support.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Tots contain slowly digestible carbs that help sustain energy and fullness.

items.title: Low in trans fats
items.content: Baking without added oil eliminates trans fats that are typical of deep‑fried snacks.

items.title: Portion control convenience
items.content: The frozen format lets you measure exact servings, helping to avoid overeating.

items.title: Calorie density
items.content: Even without added oil, tots are calorie‑dense due to potato and breadcrumb content.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salt is often added to the coating; choose low‑sodium versions if you monitor salt intake.

items.title: Potato allergy
items.content: Rare, but some individuals may react to potato or coating ingredients.

items.title: Glycemic index
items.content: Potatoes have a high glycemic index, which can cause rapid blood‑sugar spikes.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and bake the tots for 15‑20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp. Serve as a side with burgers, grilled meats, or with dipping sauces such as ketchup, mustard, or cheese sauce. They also add crunch to salads.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen tots in their original packaging in a freezer at –18 °C (0 °F). After opening, transfer to an airtight bag to prevent freezer burn. Use within 6‑12 months for best quality.
